# Third-Party Code Notice

ECoSim vendors source subsets from the following research codebases so inference
can run from one repository. These directories are not complete mirrors of the
upstream projects.

- VBD: Versatile Behavior Diffusion for Generalized Traffic Agent Simulation.
  See `third_party/VBD/README_UPSTREAM.md`.
- CATK: Closed-Loop Supervised Fine-Tuning of Tokenized Traffic Models. See
  `third_party/catk/README_UPSTREAM.md` and `third_party/catk/LICENSE`.
- SMART components are included through the CATK codebase. See
  `third_party/catk/src/smart/LICENSE.SMART`.

Before public release, confirm the final ECoSim repository license and the
redistribution terms for all vendored files.
